Oracle Fusion Logistics (OTM, GTM, WMS) 26C: what changed

We track 25 Logistics (OTM, GTM, WMS) changes in 26C, out of 106 features (our count) in Oracle's 26C What's New documents for this area. 25 of them are delivered switched on; 0 need setup or an opt-in before anyone can use them.

Oracle sources: Global Trade Management 26C What's New · Transportation Management 26C What's New · Warehouse Management 26C What's New

Delivered switched on (25)

Try the New Redwood Experience

Impact: highAutomatically onLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Global Trade Management · Redwood UI
More Transportation and Global Trade Management screens are now available in the Redwood UI, along with the Product Map navigation view and Redwood Help and Export. Where both exist the legacy screens remain, but Oracle strongly encourages moving to Redwood.
Oracle's own impact label: Larger scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Try the New Redwood Experience

Impact: highAutomatically onLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Transportation Management · Redwood UI
More Transportation and Global Trade Management screens are now available in the Redwood UI, along with the Product Map navigation view and Redwood Help and Export. Where both exist the legacy screens remain, but Oracle strongly encourages moving to Redwood.
Oracle's own impact label: Larger scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Enhancement to Restricted Party Screening Workbench

Impact: mediumAutomatically onLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Global Trade Management · Restricted Party Screening
In the Restricted Party Screening Workbench, Passed and Failed now show in green and red, and new buttons let you mark a party as Trusted, Requires Screening or Prohibited.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Enhancements to License Management

Impact: mediumAutomatically onLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Global Trade Management · Trade Compliance
License management now copes when a shipment exceeds the reserved license amount: a new Allow Supplement from Balance flag lets the assignment draw the extra from the license balance, and a new Adjust License action updates the reserved balance.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Entry Exit Configuration on Trade Incentive Programs

Impact: mediumAutomatically onLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Global Trade Management · Trade Incentive Programs
Trade Incentive Programs get a new Entry-Exit Configuration section that replaces the Applicable Profile. It supports both customs and physical inventory tracking and sets the sequence, entry-exit profile and movement type for each program.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Inline Edit Always Shows External ID (XID)

Impact: mediumAutomatically onLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Global Trade Management · Enhanced Workbench Improvements
This feature changes the behavior for the Enhanced Workbench Inline Edit so that the External ID (XID) is now always shown. Previously, the option to switch from the Global Identifier (GID) to the External Identifier (XID) was controlled using the Logic Configuration Parameter SHOW XID IN INLINE EDIT.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Set Trusted or Prohibited Party for Restricted Party Screening

Impact: mediumAutomatically onLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Global Trade Management · Restricted Party Screening
This feature allows you to designate a party in your party master as either prohibited or trusted by assigning a new status. This status provides greater control over how parties are handled during screening.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Inline Edit Always Shows External ID (XID)

Impact: mediumAutomatically onLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Transportation Management · Enhanced Workbench Improvements
This feature changes the behavior for the Enhanced Workbench Inline Edit so that the External ID (XID) is now always shown. Previously, the option to switch from the Global Identifier (GID) to the External Identifier (XID) was controlled using the Logic Configuration Parameter SHOW XID IN INLINE EDIT.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Multi-Day Calendar Overrides

Impact: mediumAutomatically onLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Transportation Management · Usability Enhancements
The Multi-Day Calendar Override feature allows you to define both a start date and time and an end date and time for your calendar override entries. With the addition of the end date, you can now apply closures or schedule exceptions across a continuous date range without needing to create multiple records.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Planner Added Documents In Tendering Workflow

Impact: mediumAutomatically onLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Transportation Management · Document Management
This feature introduces the ability for you (the planner) to upload and share documents directly within the tendering workflow. Document Actions have been added to the Spot Bid Tender screen, the Online Booking and Tendering (OBT) screen, and the (buy) Shipment to support the use case.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Rate Shopping - Rate Service Visibility - Change Service Provider

Impact: mediumAutomatically onLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Transportation Management · Usability Enhancements
This feature provides visibility to the Rate Service in external rate shopping setups where a Rate Offering setup can apply to multiple Rate Service options. In the Change Service Provider action results, you can now clearly see and select the full-service combination, including the rate service.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Improve Receiving Execution with Shipment Progress Visibility in Mobile

Impact: mediumAutomatically onLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Warehouse Management · Inbound Logistics
Warehouse operators and supervisors can now view real-time shipment receiving progress directly within Mobile receiving transactions. The enhancement provides shipment-level visibility into key receiving metrics, allowing users to monitor receiving progress without navigating to other screens or running reports.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

UPS Standard Integration Supports Shipping to Canada

Impact: mediumAutomatically onLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Warehouse Management · Outbound Logistics
The UPS Standard integration now sends an invoice line total (item unit cost times quantity), so shipments to Canada can be manifested. Item unit cost must be above zero, or manifesting may fail.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

AI Agent Studio - Seeded Business Objects

Impact: lowAutomatically onLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Global Trade Management · AI Infrastructure
Thirty ready-made OTM and GTM business objects are now available in AI Agent Studio, so you don't have to map them yourself when building your own AI agents.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Copy Additional Data from Inventory to Exit Declaration Line

Impact: lowAutomatically onLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Global Trade Management · Trade Incentive Programs
When you move goods out of a Free Trade Zone, the exit declaration line can now copy dates (such as the entry date) and zone status from inventory, based on a data configuration you define.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Redwood Theme For Enhanced Workbench

Impact: lowAutomatically onLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Global Trade Management · Enhanced Workbench Improvements
The Enhanced Workbench picks up Redwood styling: a Redwood strip across the top of layouts and Redwood colors on the side navigation bar.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Transaction Type/Declaration Type Available on Line UIs

Impact: lowAutomatically onLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Global Trade Management · Trade Compliance
The transaction type and declaration type are now shown, and searchable, on Trade Transaction Line and Declaration Line pages.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Copy Parameter Override

Impact: lowAutomatically onLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Transportation Management · Logistics Network Modeling
This feature provides you with the option of copying your Parameter Override. The new Copy Parameter Override action can be found by navigating to Logistics Network Modeling > Power Data > Parameter Overrides.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Redwood Theme For Enhanced Workbench

Enhance Queries for Wave Research Advisor AI Agent

Impact: lowAutomatically on (setup may apply)Logistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Warehouse Management · Outbound LogisticsAI agent
The Wave Research Advisor AI Agent now supports additional wave-related operational inquiries, enabling warehouse personnel to obtain more detailed allocation information through natural language interactions.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Honor Expiry Date Range Rules for Cross Dock Pick And Allocate

Impact: lowAutomatically onLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Warehouse Management · Inventory Operations
Pick and Allocate now validates picked inventory against an Expiry Date Range rule before allocation. A new mobile screen parameter , Expiry Date Range Rule, controls this behaviour.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Honor Expiry Date Range Rules for Direct Allocation

Impact: lowAutomatically onLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Warehouse Management · Inventory Operations
Direct Allocation now supports expiry date validation during allocation. A new screen parameter, Expiry Date Range Rule , lets customers define which expiry date range rule WMS applies when users allocate inventory from a scanned LPN or pallet to an order.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Honor Expiry Date Range, Order Prioritization Rules for Distribute LPN

Impact: lowAutomatically onLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Warehouse Management · Inventory Operations
Distribute LPN can now use Crossdock Flowthrough Rules to decide which received inventory flows straight to which outbound order, based on inventory details, expiry date range, order criteria and priority.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

View Employee Timeline Metrics

Impact: lowAutomatically on (setup may apply)Logistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Warehouse Management · Warehouse Workforce Management
A new Employee Timeline Metrics tab in the WFM Employee Dashboard shows each employee's day in one place: facility clock-in and clock-out, work area activity and breaks.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source
